description:
The account's default model and settings for one kind of generation,
used when neither the call nor the item's prompt editor names one.
voice_block needs provider and segment_video needs talking_head: each
family keeps its own default.

generation.description: script_scan is Analyze Script; *_reference, reference images; voice_block, the voiceover; segment_image, a segment's image; segment_video, a clip; art_style_*_template, the style's template images

model.description: set_model_default: a model id from get_generation_options

provider.description: voice_block: the voice engine (the project's voice_tts_provider)

settings.description: Model settings: keys of its settings_schema

talking_head.description: segment_video: true for talking head models, false for clips

name: account_edit
title: Edit account
